concept: Independently randomized opening-era courtyard and travel trunk action
negative_en: plastic-looking skin, illustration look, body distortion, low resolution, cartoon style, fake-looking background, over-processed retouching
prompt_en:
Create a realistic color editorial photograph of an adult woman, using the supplied portrait solely for her visible adult facial appearance: softly oval face, dark brown eyes, full natural lips, fair skin and long dark wavy hair. Place her in a Korean opening-era, early Korean Empire inspired outdoor courtyard just after a shower. A low traditional building with curved dark roof tiles and wooden posts adjoins a red brick legation wall, with a plain iron street lamp beyond the gate. She wears a cream jeogori with overlapping front, narrow tied goreum ribbons and a muted jade full-length chima, the high gathered skirt spreading over a worn stone step. Her hair is loosely gathered at the nape with some face-framing waves. In a single visible moment, she leans forward to close a small wooden travel trunk on the step: her left palm presses the lid downward while her right hand draws a loose burgundy silk ribbon clear of the closing edge. Wind lifts the free ribbon end sideways, and the trunk lid remains visibly ajar beneath her palm. Brass trunk corners and the visible gap establish the action. A folded newspaper with small vertical printed columns rests on the trunk's far corner, beside a plain cloth-wrapped parcel. Her eyes follow her right hand with concentrated calm. Prioritize readable hand-to-lid and hand-to-ribbon contact, historically coherent traditional clothing, the meeting of timber-and-tile architecture with brick and iron, and a recognizable visible likeness to the portrait. Frame a three-quarter-length environmental portrait at eye level, retaining the skirt, step, both hands and trunk. Soft post-rain daylight reveals damp stone reflections, matte fabric weave, weathered wood and natural skin texture; restrained jade, cream, burgundy and brick colors make one coherent photographic scene. Place the trunk diagonally across the lower right foreground so both wrists separate clearly against the jade skirt. Broad light from camera left catches the lid gap and the lifted ribbon while keeping the brick-and-tile junction legible.

Avoid: plastic-looking skin, illustration look, body distortion, low resolution, cartoon style, fake-looking background, over-processed retouching
